workingTree: Uncommitted; source hashes below bind the evidence. No push, merge or deployment.

included: real Figma Chrome exports and current five-build readbacks

figma.exportChannel: real Chrome UI Export 16 layers; downloaded ZIP; MCP only for node construction and parameter readback
figma.normalization: Kernel width/height, transforms, node/paint opacity, radii and smoothing use actual Figma readback values; required kernel effect color fields supplied explicitly.
figma.coverageWarning: These denominators describe this finite controlled corpus, not Figma feature completion or all user designs.
figma.channelDifferenceCause: Not established; never replace browser references with MCP renderings.

fixes.problem: Repeated closing endpoint leaves the uniform closed-stroke seam with a zero-length neighbor, suppressing the join.
fixes.change: Normalize repeated closed endpoint before constructing quads and miter/round/bevel joins; same rule as variable-width route.
fixes.regression: Cyclic start vertices, reverse winding, explicit repeat twice, three joins, uniform and variable width; all four rectangle corners in three CPU profiles.
fixes.remaining: The 1/255 external differences still fail acceptance.

fixes.problem: Cubic boundary formula loses small nonzero radii through cancellation and squared/cubed underflow; can yield NaN.
fixes.change: For 0<r<=1 use center 1-r/3, adjacent coefficient r/6 and zero outside support; GPU side division uses divideRN.
fixes.independentDerivation: integral from 0 to r of t*(r-t)/r^2 dt = r/6
fixes.after: All 1044 new side/support coefficient vectors match exact Fraction/RNE on CPU, native GPU, WebGPU and WebGL2.
fixes.remaining: Does not establish correctly rounded general filter accumulation, center coefficient equivalence, or Figma blur matching.

lint.note: Existing lint warnings remain; no autofix applied.

figmaBrowserRun.failures: All twelve scene failures are analytic; fine profiles have zero differences.

figmaFiveBuildComparison.reason: External strict differences and analytic native unsupported/internal browser differences.

precisionGate.scope: Exact RGBA8 and managed binary32 bit comparisons on all requested profiles; independent arithmetic oracle. Missing backends fail. External Figma PNG similarity remains separate.

checks.gateStageBoundary: Kernel/server and frontend tests ran separately on this same source; native,browser gate ran all 147 scenes across all three profiles. No gate result marked complete.
